expectations.text: The new doc follows the house structure (Resumo, Contexto, Proposta with a Compensações subsection, Riscos, Plano de entrega) instead of the skill's default catalog
expectations.evidence: dd-2026-008-rate-limiting-api-publica.md contains all house sections in house order: '## Resumo', '## Contexto', '## Proposta' with '### Compensações' as a subsection (✓/✗ bullets), '## Riscos' as a '| Risco | Mitigação |' table, '## Plano de entrega' as a numbered list, plus the house header table ('| **Documento** | DD-2026-008 |'). Two additive top-level sections not in DD-2026-007 were inserted ('## Objetivos' and '## Alternativas consideradas'), but they carry only user-supplied content (the two measurable goals; the two discarded alternatives), and final_message.md flags the deviation ('Duas seções fugiram do DD-2026-007 ... me avisa se o padrão da casa preferir esse material dentro do Contexto e da Proposta'). The skill's default English section catalog is not used.

expectations.text: The house ID convention continues: DD-2026-008 in the filename and header table
expectations.evidence: File saved as docs/design/dd-2026-008-rate-limiting-api-publica.md (continuing dd-2026-NNN-slug after dd-2026-007); title '# DD-2026-008 · Rate limiting da API pública' and header table row '| **Documento** | DD-2026-008 |'.

expectations.text: The retracted NAT/shared-IP false positive is NOT listed as a risk
expectations.evidence: The '## Riscos' table has a single row about Redis contention. NAT appears only in Proposta as a design property, per the user's retraction: 'Como o limite é por token e não por IP, clientes distintos atrás de um NAT compartilhado não geram falsos positivos'. final_message.md: 'registrei como característica do design ... não como risco, já que vocês concluíram que ele não existe.'

expectations.text: Content is faithful to the prompt: INC-4412, 40x traffic, 25 minutes of outage, per-plan limits (10/100 rps), and 429 with Retry-After are all present
expectations.evidence: Contexto: 'um cliente com integração mal feita enviou 40× o tráfego normal e derrubou a API pública para todos os clientes por 25 minutos (incidente INC-4412)'. Plan table: '| Free | 10 rps |', '| Pro | 100 rps |', '| Enterprise | Negociado por contrato |'. Proposta: 'o gateway responde `429 Too Many Requests` com o header `Retry-After`'. The date 'Em 2026-07-06' is derived from the prompt's 'ontem' relative to the run date (2026-07-07), not fabricated.

expectations.text: The Black Friday trade-off appears as an explicit cost (✗) together with its mitigation
expectations.evidence: Compensações: '✗ Cliente legítimo em pico (ex.: Black Friday) pode receber `429`; mitigamos com o `Retry-After` e com um alerta para o time de contas avisar os clientes enterprise' — cost marked ✗ with both mitigations in the same bullet.

expectations.text: Redis contention is the listed risk, with the measure-before-rollout mitigation
expectations.evidence: Riscos table: '| O Redis de sessão virar ponto de contenção com os contadores de rate limit | Medir a carga no Redis antes de ativar o enforcing — a fase de shadow mode mede sem aplicar limite |' — the prompt's risk with the measure-before-enforcing mitigation.
